mapper.select: SELECT id, city_code, year, month, price FROM t_monthly_price WHERE city_code = #{cityCode} AND price IS NOT NULL ORDER BY year, month

SELECT c.city_code, c.city_name, c.province_name, c.lon, c.lat, m.price, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY m.price DESC ASC ) AS rank FROM t_monthly_price m JOIN t_city c ON c.city_code = m.city_code WHERE m.year = #{year} AND m.month = #{month} AND m.price IS NOT NULL LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.city_code, c.city_name, c.province_name, c.lon, c.lat, prev.price AS start_price, curr.price AS end_price, CASE WHEN prev.price > 0 THEN ROUND((curr.price - prev.price) / prev.price * 100, 2) ELSE NULL END AS change_pct FROM t_monthly_price curr JOIN t_city c ON c.city_code = curr.city_code LEFT JOIN t_monthly_price prev ON prev.city_code = curr.city_code AND ( (prev.year = curr.year AND prev.month = curr.month - 1) OR (curr.month = 1 AND prev.year = curr.year - 1 AND prev.month = 12) ) WHERE curr.year = #{year} AND curr.month = #{month} AND curr.price IS NOT NULL ORDER BY change_pct DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT c.city_code, c.city_name, c.province_name, c.lon, c.lat, s.price AS start_price, e.price AS end_price, CASE WHEN s.price > 0 THEN ROUND((e.price - s.price) / s.price * 100, 2) ELSE NULL END AS change_pct FROM t_monthly_price s JOIN t_monthly_price e ON e.city_code = s.city_code AND e.year = #{endYear} AND e.month = #{endMonth} JOIN t_city c ON c.city_code = s.city_code WHERE s.year = #{startYear} AND s.month = #{startMonth} AND s.price IS NOT NULL AND e.price IS NOT NULL ORDER BY change_pct DESC ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT #{limit}
